nom: THAYERS Original Witch Hazel Astringent with Aloe Vera

avis.texte: "Thayers Witch Hazel" has been around for a long time, and is an excellent product for what it is intended - a moisturizing skin toner. It has very little odor, is clean and refreshing, and will tone and tighten your skin. It's also an astringent in addition to this particular product's alcohol base, so has some mild antibacterial properties. And it does contain some witch hazel extract - fourth ingredient down. It works great for a stand-alone aftershave, or a soothing lotion for irritated skin. Lots of natural ingredients, so not packed with mysterious chemicals. And Thayers comes in a dizzying array of scents and varieties - Lavender, Cucumber, Lemon, Rose, astringent pads, mouth spray, alcohol and alcohol-free, to name a few. So 5 stars for a great, all-purpose skin toner, antiseptic and aftershave. What it is not: It is not, of course, witch hazel. Really, no commercial product is "witch hazel," unless you are referring to the plant, Hamamelis Virginiana. Many cosmetic products including this one contain witch hazel extract, which is prepared by distilling witch hazel leaves, twigs and bark in an alcohol solution, resulting in (usually) about a 14% alcohol/water solution containing essential oils and organics from the witch hazel plant. There is no such thing as "pure" witch hazel, unless you are referring to this extract or the plant itself. avis.titre: Obsessed! My Daily Go-To for Head-to-Toe Refresh
avis.texte: I’m absolutely in love with the THAYERS Original Witch Hazel Astringent with Aloe Vera. It’s become a staple in my skincare and self-care routine. I pair it with the Thayers Blemish Clearing Acne Pads and the Alcohol-Free Rose Petal Witch Hazel Toner, and together they create the perfect trifecta for clean, glowing, balanced skin. This astringent is gentle yet effective—I use it morning and night, right after showers. And not just on my face! I apply it to my scalp, neck, underarms, and anywhere I want to feel refreshed and soothed. The aloe vera adds a calming touch, and the witch hazel keeps my skin feeling clean without drying it out. If you’re looking for a versatile, skin-loving product line that delivers results and smells amazing, Thayers is it. Total game-changer!

This is the best astringent on the market. I have tried several astringents from some of the top beauty lines, where the astringent is much more expensive and you'd obviously expect it to work better. But it did not. I not only have Thayers astringent I also use various other products that they have and I am thoroughly impressed. I like this astringent, because it doesn't have a alcohol base, like other astringents, I find have a burning tingling feeling that I do not like on my skin, and I'm sure it's probably not good for the skin because of that. But this is so smooth. It's so versatile, it's easy to apply and the bottle lasts at least two months. This is astringent I highly recommend.
I like this much better than my aftershave lotions. Makes my skin feel great.

The reason why I love this one is because the aloe Vera makes your face softer and less dry. However if Humphreys or Dickson has one with aloe Vera that find im definitely getting that over this. I will try each one and see which I like more. You might ask well should I buy it? My answer is if you like to give it a try sure if your just looking for witch Hazel as a toner, than there's better value for the same thing. I have seen a big bottle of Humphreys or Dickson witch Hazel in Marshall's from 4 to 6 dollars.

avis.titre: Great quality astringent pads that really work!
avis.texte: Thayer's Original Witch Hazel pads are large, thick, textured cleansing pads. They have a pleasant smell, unlike other astringent products, and the aloe vera gives a cool, soothing effect without stinging, and reduces the dry skin feeling common to using witch hazel.

I recently purchased this toner from Amazon, and I'm quite pleased with it. It comes in well-designed packaging, and the scent is pleasant. Given my oily skin, I find it suitable for my skin type, as well as for those with oily or combination skin. In fact, I believe it could work well for all skin types. I've experienced no irritation or adverse reactions after using it. The scent is appealing, and the fact that it's colorless is a bonus. I typically use it after washing my face and removing makeup. What's particularly satisfying is that even after washing my face, I can still see residual dirt on the cotton pad when I use this toner. It effectively cleanses my skin, and I can visibly see the difference it makes. Overall, I'm quite fond of this toner and find it effective in keeping my skin clean and refreshed.
